name: What is the difference between re-stucco and stucco repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between re-stucco and stucco repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco repair typically addresses localized damage, such as small cracks, holes, or minor areas of deterioration, restoring the existing stucco's integrity in specific spots. Re-stucco, on the other hand, involves applying an entirely new layer of stucco over a significant portion or the entire exterior of a building. Re-stucco is chosen for widespread damage, a complete aesthetic overhaul, or when existing stucco is severely compromised, offering a uniform, fresh appearance rather than patch-up work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair fixes localized damage, while re-stucco applies a new layer over a large area or entire exterior for widespread damage or a complete aesthetic change.
